property_summary: For any callee address that reverts on fallback, calling C.forward(callee, data) always reverts in the reference (require checks the call result) but the mutant that drops the require will succeed — so the reference always propagates a failing external call as a revert, whereas the mutant sometimes does not.
change_summary: Drop the require so failures of the external call are ignored; this changes observable behavior because forward may revert originally but now will not, changing post-call state visibility.
